title: Pointwise nonemptiness of a fibre product over an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $C$ and $U$ be schemes over $S$ with morphisms $c:C	o E$ and $u:U	o E$. If points $x\in|C|$ and $y\in|U|$ have the same image in the point set $|E|$ of the algebraic space (equivalently, their maps from spectra of fields become equal after a common field extension), then the scheme fibre product $C	imes_EU$ has a point whose projections map to $x$ and $y$ (after that common field extension). In particular, if every point of $c(C)$ lies in the image of $u$, then the projection $C	imes_EU	o C$ is surjective.

source.place: Tag 03H4 (spaces-properties, lemma-points-cartesian), the pointwise fibre-product criterion for an algebraic space; the equivalent common-field formulation is part of the definition of points of an algebraic space.
